name: brand-lychee
title: Lychee brand theme
description: The lychee theme (리치), a neutral alternate look: an achromatic charcoal brand over a true-grey paper (neutral chroma 0), with a calm blue accent split off for links, the focus ring and selection (ADR-0023). Type, spacing, radius, motion and the translucent overlay are mango's. Select it with `data-brand="lychee"` on <html>; with no such attribute the default brand from `styles` renders. Install both: import order does not matter, the cascade is decided by selector specificity.
